correctness.rationale: The full 4n-dimensional regular convolution decomposes into 2n exact two-dimensional Fourier fibers; determinant/diagonal root-of-unity constraints are exhaustive, rank boundaries are explicit, CRT counts unique supports with correct 3! and 2! divisions, and divisor sums prove total counts and sharpness for every n>=2. Modular direct-matrix tests (1081 sampled supports, n 2–12) and independent exhaustive arithmetic count comparisons (every n 2–24) passed; they are not substituted for the infinite proof.
